title: The 10 Best Tonneau Covers
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for tonneau covers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at tonneau covers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: BAK BAKFlip MX4 Hard Folding Truck Bed Tonneau Cover, Fits 2015-2020 Ford F-150 5'7" Bed
products.blurb: Key specs: Hard folding tri-panel aluminum design, 500 lb distributed weight rating, Automatic panel latching as the cover closes.
strengths: 500 lb weight rating leads every folding cover compared here
No-drill stake pocket install avoids permanent modification to the bed rail
Automatic latching removes a manual locking step other folding covers require
limitations: Two-person install recommended to square the rails before latching
Folded panel stack near the cab needs clearance for tall cab-mounted accessories
features: Hard folding tri-panel aluminum design
500 lb distributed weight rating
Automatic panel latching as the cover closes
No-drill clamp-on stake pocket mount
